proposals.before: Having passed the jinshi examination in Kangxi 3 (1664), he was appointed investigating censor of Pingyuan in Guizhou.
proposals.after: Having passed the jinshi examination in Kangxi 3 (1664), he was appointed prefectural judge of Pingyuan in Guizhou.
proposals.reason: 推官 is a prefectural judicial post, not an investigating censor.

proposals.before: A jinshi of the third year of Kangxi, he was appointed investigating censor of Pingyuan in Guizhou.
proposals.after: A jinshi of the third year of Kangxi, he was appointed prefectural judge of Pingyuan in Guizhou.
proposals.reason: 推官 is a prefectural judicial post, not an investigating censor.

proposals.before: He repaired the walls and moat, restored schools, lectured at the academy on the classics and the Song Neo-Confucian traditions of Zhou Dunyi, the Cheng brothers, Zhang Zai, and the Fujian school, and scholarly morale revived sharply.
proposals.after: He repaired the walls and moat, restored schools, lectured at the academy on the classics and histories and the Lian, Luo, Guan, and Min schools, and scholarly morale revived sharply.
proposals.reason: The Chinese names the four Neo-Confucian school labels 濂、洛、關、閩, not the individual masters inserted by the idiomatic expansion.

proposals.before: After three years in office he died.
proposals.reason: 居三年，卒 means three years later he died; the literal invents 'in office'.

proposals.before: In a separate memorial he said Jiangning's market taxes burdened the people with house tax, gallery fees, and shed rent, and asked that they be remitted."
proposals.after: In a separate memorial he said Jiangning's market taxes burdened the people with house tax, gallery fees, and shed rent, and asked that they be remitted.
proposals.reason: Stray closing quotation mark at the end of the idiomatic English.

decisions.reason: s0059 has 授貴州平遠推官; 推官 is a prefectural judicial post, not an investigating censor (御史). The proposed prefectural judge wording matches the Chinese office.
The literal likewise misrenders 推官 as investigating censor. Prefectural judge of Pingyuan in Guizhou correctly translates 貴州平遠推官.

s0077 has 講論經史及濂、洛、關、閩之學: classics and histories plus the four school labels. The before text omits 史 and invents Zhou Dunyi, the Cheng brothers, Zhang Zai, and a Fujian-school gloss; the proposed after restores histories and the Lian, Luo, Guan, and Min labels.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 講論經史及濂、洛、關、閩之學

decisions.reason: 居三年，卒 states only that three years passed before death; it does not say he held office. Preceding s0124 restores rank after dismissal, so 'in office' is invented; the proposed after matches the Chinese and the idiomatic.
The idiomatic paraphrases 別疏言 without opening English quotation marks, so the trailing closing quote is a stray punctuation error; removing it is correct.
